notes.note: Durham will miss this week with a sore groin.
24 touches for Durham with this now two scores under 90 in a row for the first time since rounds 10 and 11.
Durham gave away 3 free kicks amongst his 7 tackles and 14 disposals this week. All the Bombers struggled to score with just two over 80 so nothing to worry about.
Durham was the only Bomber to crack triple figures from his 22 disposals and goal.
Durham has been a popular pick up of late and he didn't disappoint as one of just two over 100 for the Bombers. 24 disposals 9 clearances and 12 contested possessions.
Durham was talked about during the week as an option. But just the 20 disposals with 3 free kicks against for him and 7 clangers.
